analyse.title: Analyser
analyse.lead: Type or paste a phrase, or a verse reference such as 2:255, and read it word by word. Quranic text is read from the Quranic Arabic Corpus at its place; other text is matched against the Quran's own words, with how sure each reading is.
analyse.sourceVerse: Verse {ref}: the analysis is the Quranic Arabic Corpus's, word by word at its place.
analyse.sourcePhrase: The phrase occurs in verse {ref} only, so it is analysed as it stands there in the Quranic Arabic Corpus.
analyse.truncated: Only the first sixty words were analysed.
analyse.error: The analysis failed. Please try again.
analyse.method: How it works: Quranic words come from the Quranic Arabic Corpus at their place (hand-verified, confidence 1). Other words are matched to Quranic words spelled the same, the confidence being that analysis's share of those occurrences; failing that, after taking off conjunctions, prepositions, the article and attached pronouns (×0.7), then by the Quran's patterns over its roots (0.35 at most). Nothing is proposed that no Quranic word attests.
analyse.particleNotSegmented: particle or function word, not segmented
analyse.rootToConcordance: The root's lines in the concordance
analyse.how_gold: from the Quranic Arabic Corpus at its place

analyse.how_pattern: by the pattern alone; the root is a Quranic root
analyse.sourceRange: Verses {ref}: the Quranic Arabic Corpus's analysis, verse by verse, each word at its place (ten verses at most).
analyse.how_pattern_clitic: after taking off «{clitics}», by the pattern alone; the root is a Quranic root
